errors.description: The agent failed to execute a critical step in its own plan. It identified the necessity of researching botanical classifications to ensure accuracy but then deviated from this plan by skipping the research step entirely and relying on its internal knowledge.

errors.evidence:
In the 'Thought' section, the agent asserts: "Using botanical criteria:
• Sweet potatoes (storage root), broccoli (flower head), celery (stalk), and lettuce (leaves) are vegetables.
• [...]
• Green beans, bell pepper, and zucchini are technically fruits (mature ovary and seed container).
• Corn is a grain/fruit...". These specific classifications were presented as fact without any grounding tool call to verify them.
errors.description: The agent hallucinated the verification of botanical facts. It presented detailed classifications as if they were retrieved from a source, when in reality, it never used a tool to perform the planned research. It relied on ungrounded internal knowledge to answer the user's query.

It created a plan to verify information, which was the correct and safe approach, but then failed to follow it. The correct output was a matter of luck rather than a robust, verifiable procedure, making the process highly unreliable.
